# ex: needParen with different binary operator precedence
ex {
	var x int
	var y int
	x + y -> x | y
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	return (1 + 2) * 3
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F() int {
-	return (1 + 2) * 3
+	return (1 | 2) * 3
 }
